item.title: Bonnie Tyler Fans Invited to Line the Streets in Wales for Final Farewell
item.description:
[INTRO MUSIC FADES OUT]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we're taking a moment to remember a music legend. Bonnie Tyler, the iconic voice behind hits like "Total Eclipse of the Heart" and "Holding Out for a Hero", has passed away at the age of 75.
[SOFT MUSIC PLAYS IN THE BACKGROUND]
Host: A celebration of life service will be held for Tyler at Swansea Minster, St. Mary's Church, on August 17th at noon BST. Two days earlier, her coffin will be brought back to her home in Mumbles, and the public is invited to pay their respects as the procession passes through Newton Road.
[SOFT MUSIC CONTINUES]
Host: After the service, the procession will make a final journey through Skewen, the village where Tyler grew up, before a private family service. Tyler's family has remembered her as a "warm, generous artist whose music touched generations and continues to fill dance floors and karaoke booths around the world."
[MUSIC TRANSITIONS TO A CLIP OF "TOTAL ECLIPSE OF THE HEART"]
Host: With a career spanning over five decades, Tyler released 18 studio albums and became one of the most recognizable voices in pop-rock. Her signature hit, "Total Eclipse of the Heart", topped the Billboard Hot 100 for four weeks in 1983 and remains one of the defining pop-rock recordings of the decade.
[MUSIC FADES OUT]
Host: Tyler's family has requested that donations be made to Noah's Ark Children's Hospital for Wales and Cerebral Palsy Cymru, two charities that she supported as a patron. If you'd like to honor her memory, you can consider making a donation to one of these worthy causes.
[CLOSE-OUT MUSIC STARTS PLAYING]
Host: That's all for today. We'll miss Bonnie Tyler's incredible voice, but her legacy lives on in the timeless songs that made her a legend. Thank you for listening, and we'll be back with more music news soon.
[CLOSE-OUT MUSIC CONTINUES TO PLAY AS THE PODCAST ENDS]
